title: Easy to Assemble; replaces box spring and base
text: Easy to Assemble; replaces box spring and base. I needed a new bed (mattress and box springs).  When I saw this was available, I ordered it right away, as it eliminates the need for the box springs.  It's a base and mattress foundation all in one, so you can put your mattress right on top of this.  It appears to be well made and strong enough to hold a mattress and the weight of two sleepers.  Another Zinus bed frame I had did not look very strong and was poor quality.  This one, however, seems to be much better quality.  Assembly was very easy.  You can almost do it alone, but it helps to have someone hold some of the pieces while you put in the screws.  Two of us put it together in under 1/2 hour.  The illustrated assembly instructions are easy to understand.  You do not need any tools, as it comes with an Allen wrench, which is the only tool you need to assemble it.  The screws went in easily and seemed to fit well and were tight.  Nice clearance underneath, so you can clean under it.  My current bed has to be moved to clean under it, which is a major job.  There are mounting holes in the two end pieces so you can add a headboard and foot-board if you wish (not included).  That would keep the mattress from sliding around, as I have some concern that it might, as there is nothing to keep it in place other than gravity.  Of course on any bed, the mattress just sits on the box spring anyway, with nothing to secure it, so this is no different.  I have yet to sleep on it, but I am sure it will be fine. (Waiting for a good mattress sale.)  I will update the review after I have slept on it.  I don't think you can go wrong with this if you are looking to replace your whole bed.  Don't buy if you want a fancy looking bed with woodwork.

Eliminates the need for a traditional box spring and bed frame
Compact design allows for tight spaces such as staircases and doorways
Multiple points of contact to the floor for level support
Sturdy steel structure protects your mattress by providing strong support
description: The Easy to Assemble SmartBase is an innovative mattress foundation by Zinus. No need for a box spring and a traditional frame, enjoy strong, sturdy support for your spring, memory foam, or latex mattress with the Easy to Assemble SmartBase. The Easy to Assemble SmartBase provides strong steel support, easy setup and 12.5 Inch of clearance for under bed storage. Worry free 5 year limited warranty. Another comfort innovation from Zinus. Pioneering comfort.
